const token = $json;
const md = `🚀 *HIGH-CONVICTION OPPORTUNITY DETECTED*

` +
`*Token:* ${token.name} (${token.symbol})
` +
`*Chain:* \`${token.chain_id}\`
` +
`*Composite Score:* *${token.composite_score}/100*

` +
`*Metrics:*
` +
`• Market Momentum: ${token.breakdown.market_momentum_score}/100
` +
`• Security Score: ${token.breakdown.security_safety_score}/100
` +
`• Wallet Intelligence: ${token.breakdown.wallet_intelligence_score}/100
` +
`• Narrative Buzz: ${token.breakdown.narrative_sentiment_score}/100

` +
`*Status:* 🟢 VERIFIED (Zero Honeypot, Renounced Mint)`;

return [{
  json: {
    chat_id: '{{ $env.TELEGRAM_ALERTS_CHAT_ID }}',
    text: md,
    parse_mode: 'Markdown'
  }
}];
